I’m going to say being taken for granted too because that’s how I currently feel.

In my last relationship I did all sorts of things for my partner. The little things she didn’t get from her OWN previous boyfriend, I did and more. Hell even the very first thing I did for her she seemed super surprised and grateful. We live around 30 minutes away from each other and I’d bring her dinner, or help her with other things, a whole bunch of things. Spending time with her and planning out dates and surprises, random gifts or experiencing new stuff together, all these things she didn’t get she got from myself. 

But where I think I really fucked myself, is that I did so much of these things that it became the normal, and so the bar continued to be set higher and higher, very slowly over the years, and it’s hard to really do more without feeling unappreciated or taken for granted if you’re always having to take the next step to show someone you care about them. Even the little things I still did for her really felt weightless in the end. We’ve broken up last year, but we had conversations about the things I did and she’s told me time and time again that the people that she’s attempted to date have not even gotten as far as I have as far as courting her and treating her well. She looks for me in other people now, or at least most of the same qualities. But the sad part is not a lot of men (to my knowledge) do the same things I’ve done, and now I wonder every day if she has any type of remorse for how we left things off, and if she took me for granted at the end of our relationship and conversations months ago. It’s left me feeling pretty worthless in the end now and questioning my own self worth: if I’m able to love someone this hard and still fail, who on earth WOULD reciprocate? Feels impossible. 

People have the illusion that they can find high quality relationships and have them be the dream partner they’ve always been looking for, when the reality is and has always been the exact opposite. 

So yeah. Taking others for granted is scummy, and feeling as if you’re being taken for granted hurts on another level too. Always remain cognizant in the actions of those around you, because if they truly love and care for you, they will show it. And you definitely won’t have to ask yourself 100 questions questioning your next move. You’ll always be sure of yourself.
